analysis_role: Post-exposure exploratory season-defined direct positive detection contrast; not recruitment, movement rate or an independent EOG forecast

cohort.source: ID must have nest observations on exactly one Island code in the entire eligible 1994–2014 date window
cohort.birth_time: earliest physically dated nest observation, not source Year or retrospective Least_age
cohort.excluded_2014_nests: No complete next-calendar-year May–August 2015 outcome inside permitted 2014 cutoff; never read 2015 records
cohort.out_of_season_birth: Exclude earliest nest dated outside May–August and report aggregate count
cohort.qualifying_followup: literal capt/obs event strictly after earliest nest, within the next calendar year Y+1 and May–August inclusive
cohort.next_breeding_classification: Use all Island codes on the earliest qualifying followup physical date; same, different or ambiguous if conflicting
cohort.first_raw_classification: Among qualifying IDs, use earliest strictly later capt/obs date anywhere in 1994–2014; same, different or ambiguous
cohort.matrix: Cross-tabulate first raw classification against next-calendar-year breeding-season classification on the SAME IDs
cohort.non_detection: No qualifying capt/obs means no observed next-season positive; it is NOT surveyed absence

published_methods.study: Ranke et al. 2021 Journal of Animal Ecology
published_methods.interpretation: Second-calendar-year recorded recruits defined for original study; May–August here is a broad calendar convention, NOT a verified individual breeding status or equal-effort survey window.
